mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the load was most worthwhile because it connected the constructed sensory and motor pathways to an everyday action. The three described panels make the sequence easy to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the cup in the arm was a straightforward setup step with little to discover on its own.

surprise.text: The stretched spindle produced more closely spaced signal marks, giving a concrete picture of how stretch information can change.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The sensory slot made the purpose of attaching the spindle and fiber clear, although the construction simplified how the parts connect.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: using the completed pathways to explain the heavier cup made me curious about how the next body system might connect to the arm.
